title: SpecterBrowserConfig
description: Configuration schema for Specter Dedicated Isolated Chromium Runtime (~/.specter/browser/browser.json)

default_cdp_port.description: Default DevTools CDP debugging port for browser automation

headless.description: Launch browser in headless mode by default

lts_version.description: Target Chromium Golden LTS engine version

custom_binary_path.description: Optional absolute path override to custom Chromium executable

default_proxy.description: Default proxy server URL for launched browser sessions (e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:1080)

default_profile.description: Default browser profile name when omitted in 'specter browser launch'
